scope: US public Square Support Center documentation, operations domain: catalog and item variants/options; inventory counts, adjustments, transfers and purchasing; vendors; staff permissions and time tracking; cash drawers and closeout; reporting; location and hardware conditions. Checkout, payment acceptance, tax, discounts, tips, refunds and receipts are assigned to another Square researcher. Adjacent Square Payroll and financial/banking services are recorded as coverage exclusions; this bundle makes no product implementation commitment for those services.

sources.title: Create and edit item options and variations
sources.section: About custom item variations and option sets; Step 1: Create Variations; Step 2: Create and manage option sets
qualifiers: requires item library and relevant permissions
sources.evidence_note: Fixed variations can have distinct cost, price and SKU; reusable option sets can generate variation combinations. Variations are fixed product forms, distinct from sale-time modifiers.

sources.title: Adjust inventory levels
sources.section: About inventory tracking; Before you begin; Adjust inventory levels
sources.evidence_note: Tracked stock updates from POS sales, Square Invoices and online store shipped orders. Dashboard supports per-variation tracking, manual changes and bulk import; stock actions accept reasons; modal supports keyboard navigation.

sources.title: Conduct, review, and approve inventory counts
sources.section: About inventory counts; Before you begin; Conduct a full inventory count
qualifiers: Square Plus/Premium; device support includes iOS and Android, Register, Terminal and Handheld
review and approval required for full count
sources.evidence_note: Full and cycle counts are supported. Full count sets uncounted stock to zero; cycle count leaves excluded items unchanged. Cycle count frequency recommendation is at least every 90 days. Counts accept configured units with conversion.

sources.title: View and export inventory variance report
sources.section: About inventory variance reports; Before you begin; Export inventory variance report
qualifiers: Retail Plus/Premium or Square Plus/Premium with advanced inventory capabilities
ongoing cycle count blocks full-count access
sources.evidence_note: Completed counts can be reviewed; Items CSV includes counts and variance, Count summary CSV includes counters, reviewers and timestamps. Missing unit costs can make inventory value and total variance inaccurate.

sources.title: Create and manage purchase orders
sources.section: About purchase orders; Before you begin; Create purchase orders
qualifiers: Retail Plus/Premium or Plus/Premium with advanced inventory; retail mode for POS app
POS creation supports iOS; not available in-app on Square Terminal
maximum 500 unique items; quantities whole-number only
sources.evidence_note: POs can be created in Dashboard or eligible POS, include vendor, delivery location, expected date, items and optional tax/note, and be sent or saved as PDF/CSV. Editing does not automatically email an updated PO.

sources.title: Create, import, edit, and deactivate vendors
sources.section: About managing vendors; Create a vendor
qualifiers: Retail Plus/Premium, Restaurants Plus/Premium, or Square Plus/Premium with advanced inventory/restaurants capabilities
sources.evidence_note: Vendor directory supports create/import/edit/deactivate; item-level SKU and vendor codes can aid matching, and barcode vendor codes can be scanned to receive stock for orders in Retail POS.

sources.title: Create and manage transfer orders
qualifiers: Retail inventory feature; specific plans/device eligibility not fully surfaced in search result, inspect full page before relying on detailed limits
sources.evidence_note: Official guide index confirms transfer-order workflow and search by transfer number, item, variation and tracking number; detailed transfer lifecycle has not been inspected in this pass.

sources.title: Create and edit permission sets
sources.section: About permission sets; Create a custom permission set
sources.evidence_note: Permission sets specify team member access, can be customized and assigned access points; full access includes all permissions except bank-account management. Shared team passcodes do not attribute sales, time or activity to individual members.

sources.title: Set up time tracking
sources.section: About time tracking; Before you begin
qualifiers: Shifts Free/Plus, Retail Free/Plus/Premium, Restaurants Free/Plus/Premium, Square Plus/Premium
personal passcode required for team clock-in
sources.evidence_note: Timecards record in-progress/completed shifts; track hours, breaks, shift history and overtime; team members may clock in/out and view or print workday summaries.

sources.title: Start and end a cash drawer session
sources.section: About cash drawer sessions; Start a cash drawer session; Record cash paid in/out; End a cash drawer session
qualifiers: session starts from POS app, not Dashboard
remote Dashboard end prevents subsequent Pay In/Out
sources.evidence_note: Drawer session records opening cash, sales/refunds, paid-in/out and expected cash; ending records actual amount, distinct from simply ending. Sessions open over 30 days with 7 inactive days auto-end.

sources.title: View cash drawer reports
sources.section: About cash drawer reports; View your drawer history
qualifiers: POS report requires compatible drawer connected to printer and Cash Drawer Management enabled
sources.evidence_note: Drawer history can be viewed in Dashboard or POS; Dashboard filters dates/location and adds paid-in/out, device and location columns. Dashboard cash drawer reports cannot be printed or exported.

sources.title: Set up and run your restaurant’s close of day report
qualifiers: full, quick-service or bar mode on Register or compatible iPad
sources.evidence_note: Managers can configure closeout requirements for open checks, tip adjustments, cash drawer totals and clock-outs; report summarizes checks, gross/net sales, payment methods, categories and items.

sources.title: Print, export, or email your reports
sources.section: About printing, exporting, and emailing your reports; Before you begin
sources.evidence_note: Dashboard report export supports offline analysis, with exceptions: cash drawer reports cannot be printed/exported; custom reports can only be exported; transaction-status reports can only be printed.

claims.capability: Create fixed item variations from reusable option sets
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can represent sellable size/color variants with distinct SKU, price and cost while reusing option combinations across items.
claims.actor: Owner or team member with item permissions
claims.trigger: Merchant creates a catalog item with multiple fixed forms
claims.behavior: Create variation rows or apply a reusable option set to generate combinations; each variation can retain its own SKU, price and cost.
preconditions: An item exists in the item library
qualifiers: Options are fixed product variants; sale-time customization is a separate modifier concept
recovery_edge_cases: Option-set and modifier behavior needs detailed guide inspection before treating all customization workflows as covered.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure time and error rate to create a batch of variants across multiple products; improve reuse and validation if duplicate or inconsistent option sets are common.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Variant maintenance is independent of payment rail; a Bitcoin tender should leave item identity and stock decrement tied to the same item/variation.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: A new tender may create integration and reconciliation work without improving catalog maintenance; preserve existing catalog IDs and stock semantics.
claims.acceptance_test: Given an item with size and color options, an authorized merchant generates the expected combinations once and reuses that set on a second item; each selected variation retains its configured SKU and price.

claims.capability: Manually adjust tracked stock with a reason
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can record a stock correction and its reason for a specific item or variation.
claims.actor: Owner or team member with item/inventory permissions
claims.trigger: Stock arrives, a count changes, or loss/damage/return is recorded
claims.behavior: With tracking enabled, user updates quantity and selects a reason; Dashboard supports per-location variation updates and keyboard navigation.
preconditions: Current Square app for mobile workflows
qualifiers: Stock workflows in Dashboard or POS; modal desktop/laptop only
per-variation tracking requires advanced stock tracking setting
recovery_edge_cases: Uninitialized items may require baseline entry; bulk tracking enable can set uncounted items to zero.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Track correction frequency, time per stock adjustment and unexplained variance; reduce repeated navigation while retaining reason attribution and auditability.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Tender rail does not change the stock adjustment job; ensure any completed Bitcoin sale posts the same item/variation decrement once.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Separate settlement and inventory systems can create duplicate or missed decrements if event ownership is unclear; test idempotent sale-to-stock linkage.
claims.acceptance_test: For a tracked variation at one location, record damaged units with reason and verify updated on-hand quantity and adjustment reason.

claims.capability: Run a cycle count without changing uncounted stock
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can verify a subset of variations periodically and preserve levels for items outside the count.
claims.trigger: Merchant begins an audit of selected stock
claims.behavior: Start a cycle count, enter or scan counted quantities using configured units, submit and review/commit the count; excluded items retain their current stock.
qualifiers: Guide recommends counting each variation at least once per 90 days
recovery_edge_cases: Full-count workflow is unavailable while a cycle count remains in progress; discard or commit the cycle count first.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure count completion time and variance resolution; make count progress and excluded-stock semantics explicit before commit.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Inventory counts remain a physical operation independent of Bitcoin; reconcile count deltas against all completed sales regardless of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: If Bitcoin sales are omitted from sales-to-stock events, physical and system counts diverge; validate every channel's decrement feed.
claims.acceptance_test: Start a cycle count containing a subset of variations, submit and approve it, then verify counted quantities are updated and a non-included variation remains unchanged.

claims.capability: Submit and approve a full physical stock count
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can reconcile all inventory at one location.
claims.trigger: Merchant conducts a complete physical stocktake
claims.behavior: Record every item/variation quantity, submit progress for review and approval.
preconditions: All stock at the location is counted before submission
qualifiers: full counts available on iOS/Android and supported Square Register, Terminal, Handheld
variance valuation depends on unit costs
recovery_edge_cases: Any uncounted stock in full count is set to zero; ongoing cycle count blocks full count access.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Reduce accidental zeroing with a pre-submit checklist for uncounted catalog items and surface missing unit costs before valuation export.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Tender does not alter physical count rules; ensure Bitcoin sales are represented in inventory movements before comparing book and physical stock.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: A count can expose prior sale-event omissions but cannot identify tender source unless reporting retains it.
claims.acceptance_test: Submit a full count containing all location items and verify count requires review and approval and updates recorded quantities.

claims.capability: Create and send or save a supplier purchase order
claims.merchant_outcome: Retail merchant can prepare a replenishment order tied to a vendor and delivery location, then share or export it.
claims.actor: Owner or team member with item/inventory permissions
claims.behavior: Create a PO in Dashboard or eligible Retail POS, select vendor/location/date and items, add optional tax/note, then send, save as draft, PDF or CSV.
preconditions: Eligible plan/capability and retail mode for POS
Vendor or ability to create one
Items exist or are entered manually
qualifiers: Retail Plus/Premium or Square Plus/Premium with advanced inventory
Maximum 500 unique items per PO; whole-number quantities only; in-app creation unavailable on Square Terminal
recovery_edge_cases: Editing does not automatically email updated PO; explicit resend required. Receiving is a separate workflow.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure order preparation time and supplier correction rate; preserve draft state and clearly distinguish saved, sent and revised versions.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Supplier purchasing is a separate merchant workflow from customer tender; do not assume Bitcoin adoption changes vendor ordering.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Adding a payment rail does not make supplier PO settlement available; avoid implying PO payment or supplier payout support.
claims.acceptance_test: Eligible user creates a PO with vendor, destination, expected date, item and quantity, saves as draft, exports it, then sends an edited version and confirms the documented explicit resend step.

claims.capability: Create, import, edit or deactivate vendor records
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can maintain a supplier directory used in purchasing.
claims.actor: Owner or team member with item/inventory permissions
claims.trigger: Merchant onboards a supplier or reconciles an item identifier
claims.behavior: Authorized user creates, imports, edits or deactivates vendors in Dashboard.
preconditions: Eligible Retail/Restaurants subscription or advanced inventory/restaurants capability
qualifiers: Barcode-based receiving described for Square Retail POS
recovery_edge_cases: Vendor lifecycle guide includes purchase-order access conditions; vendor-code matching is a separate item-level operation.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure supplier-code lookup failures and receiving corrections; guide the merchant through code mapping and surface ambiguity before stock is applied.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Vendor setup and stock receiving should remain independent of customer Bitcoin acceptance.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Do not imply Square vendor management settles supplier invoices in Bitcoin; no such behavior was documented in inspected guide.
claims.acceptance_test: Create a vendor, edit its details, then deactivate and verify it remains available in deactivated state.

claims.capability: Assign granular team permissions and shared POS access
claims.merchant_outcome: Owner can tailor what staff can see/do and which access points a permission set can use.
claims.actor: Owner or team member with team management permission
claims.trigger: Merchant onboards staff or changes responsibilities
claims.behavior: Create/edit permission set, choose standard/enhanced/full level, customize permissions and access points, then assign a passcode/access route.
qualifiers: Full access includes all permissions except bank-account management
shared team passcode does not attribute sales, time or activity to an individual
recovery_edge_cases: Shared credentials reduce individual attribution; configure individual credentials where staff-level activity tracking is needed.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure permission misconfiguration and manager access corrections; expose effective access in a role preview before saving.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Any added tender-specific actions should follow existing least-privilege controls and be attributable to the acting team member.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: A new tender may add sensitive actions; extending full access broadly would increase exposure without operational need.
claims.acceptance_test: Create a custom role with reporting but without team management, assign it to a test team member, and verify the member can access reports but cannot change permissions; shared passcode activity is clearly not presented as individual attribution.

claims.capability: Record shifts and review workday hours
claims.merchant_outcome: Team and manager can record hours, breaks, shift history and overtime and review workday summaries.
claims.actor: Team member and manager/owner with shifts permissions
claims.trigger: Team member starts or ends a work shift
claims.behavior: Team member uses personal passcode to clock in/out; timecard captures shift and break records and can be reviewed/printed as a workday summary.
qualifiers: Detailed editing, schedule and labor rule workflows not fully inspected
recovery_edge_cases: Team member without passcode cannot use the documented clock-in flow; edits to prior timecards are a separate workflow.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure missed punches and correction delay; provide a low-friction request/review path while retaining a trace of changes.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Timekeeping is independent of tender; do not infer payroll or compensation processing from shift records.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Payroll adjacency may be separately subscribed and regulated; keep recorded time data portable and clearly distinct from pay disbursement.
claims.acceptance_test: A team member with personal passcode clocks in, records a break, clocks out, and the manager views the shift duration and break in timecard history.

claims.capability: Start a cash drawer session with starting cash
claims.merchant_outcome: Cashier establishes opening cash balance for drawer session.
claims.trigger: Cash drawer begins or ends a work session
claims.behavior: With Cash Management Add-on, start the session from POS by entering starting cash and optional description.
preconditions: Cash drawer session initiated in POS
qualifiers: Dashboard remote end prevents further paid-in/out adjustments
recovery_edge_cases: Cannot start drawer from Dashboard; sessions open over 30 days with at least seven days inactive auto-end.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure drawer variance and close duration; make expected balance, paid-in/out reasons and remote-end consequences visible before a manager closes.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Bitcoin tender can reduce physical cash tender volume while leaving a cash drawer workflow necessary for cash sales and payouts; retain cash closeout for remaining cash jobs.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: If non-cash tender is mixed into drawer expectations incorrectly, variance becomes misleading; separate tender settlement from counted physical cash and test mixed-tender closeout.
claims.acceptance_test: Start drawer in POS with starting amount and verify Dashboard cannot start a session.

claims.capability: Review cash drawer history with session detail
claims.merchant_outcome: Owner/manager can inspect drawer sessions by date and location and see device and cash movements.
claims.actor: Owner or team member with reports permission
claims.trigger: Manager reviews cash drawer closeout or variance
claims.behavior: View drawer history in Dashboard or POS; Dashboard filters date/location and can add paid-in/out, device and location columns.
preconditions: POS view requires connected drawer/printer and Cash Drawer Management
qualifiers: Dashboard cash drawer reports cannot be printed or exported
recovery_edge_cases: For offline analysis, Dashboard cash drawer export is unavailable in the inspected guide; POS may email/print with supported printer.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure closeout investigation time; provide a permitted portable audit format while preserving session detail and access controls.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Separate Bitcoin receipts from drawer cash totals while allowing the merchant to compare tender summaries during closeout.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Dashboard export limitation may complicate reconciliation; any additional report must clearly distinguish payment settlement records from physical drawer movements.
claims.acceptance_test: A reports-authorized manager filters drawer sessions by date and location and sees paid-in/out, device and location details; the UI communicates Dashboard export/print limitation and supported POS email/print path.

claims.capability: Configure restaurant end-of-day requirements and run closeout report
claims.merchant_outcome: Restaurant manager can require key close tasks and review a day summary before the restaurant closes.
claims.behavior: Configure requirements for open checks, tip adjustments, drawer totals and clock-outs; run close-of-day report showing check details, gross/net sales, payment methods, categories and items.
preconditions: Full service, quick service or bar mode on supported Register/iPad
qualifiers: Restaurants Plus/Premium or Square Plus/Premium documented
recovery_edge_cases: Staff may need to declare cash tips before clock-out; exact behavior depends on enabled procedures and staff still clocked in.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure incomplete close tasks and next-day corrections; clearly identify blockers and accountable staff before the manager finalizes day close.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: A Bitcoin payment method should appear distinctly in the tender summary while preserving close tasks for open checks, drawers and clocked-in staff.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Settlement timing and tender conversion can differ from sales day boundaries; report should avoid presenting settlement as equivalent to sales recognition.
claims.acceptance_test: At a configured restaurant location, leave one required close task incomplete and verify the manager can identify it; after completion run report and reconcile checks, sales, payment methods, category and item summaries.

claims.capability: Export or email eligible reports for offline analysis
claims.merchant_outcome: Manager can retain or further analyze reporting data outside Dashboard or POS where supported.
claims.actor: Owner or team member with reports permission
claims.trigger: Merchant needs offline records or custom analysis
claims.behavior: Select eligible report and print, download, export or email it; Dashboard custom reports are export-only and transaction-status reports print-only.
qualifiers: Cash drawer reports excluded from Dashboard print/export
recovery_edge_cases: The report type determines available output; don't promise a universal export format or export path.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure failed export attempts and manual reconciliation time; disclose format and channel limitations before users configure reports.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: If a merchant accepts Bitcoin, export should preserve tender identity, timing and amount fields needed to reconcile sales with settlement without replacing existing report exports.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: A new tender may create sensitive financial records and accounting complexity; validate privacy, timestamp, denomination and conversion fields with merchants before design.
claims.acceptance_test: For a standard eligible report, export or email the report and verify rows remain analyzable; for custom, transaction-status and cash drawer reports, verify the documented output limitation is accurately shown.

claims.capability: Export filtered item library
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can review/edit selected catalog scope offline.
claims.behavior: Filter and export all or matching items as Excel/CSV.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Filtered export is only currently viewed items; CSV cannot edit unit types/precision; spreadsheet software may alter leading-zero SKU.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure reimport errors; preview scope and row count.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Tender does not alter catalog export.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Keep customer/payment data separate from catalog export.
claims.acceptance_test: Export filtered items and verify only matching rows and identifiers are present.

claims.capability: Bulk import item updates
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can update many items in one upload.
claims.behavior: Prepare template, upload spreadsheet, map columns, correct errors.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: CSV cannot update unit precision; nested modifier relationships need Dashboard; SKU leading zero corruption risk.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure import error and recovery rates.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Payment rail does not change import.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Separate catalog and financial data.
claims.acceptance_test: Import valid catalog and malformed row; verify errors are surfaced for correction.

claims.capability: Mark modifier sold out per location
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can prevent unavailable add-on selection.
claims.behavior: Toggle modifier in-stock off at affected location.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Sold-out-last keeps visible; nested modifier behavior differs by surface.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure wrong modifier picks after depletion.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Availability independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Bitcoin tender must honor same state.
claims.acceptance_test: Mark sold out at one location and verify location-specific availability and configured visibility.

claims.capability: Create location stock transfer
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can plan inter-store movement.
claims.behavior: Create Dashboard order with source/destination/date/tracking/items; draft/create/export.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Only origin-available items listed; receive is separate.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure transfer prep and mismatch.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Transfer independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Tender does not change inventory location.
claims.acceptance_test: Create transfer draft between two locations and verify source/destination/item constraints.

claims.capability: Receive full or partial transfer
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can reconcile delivered quantities.
claims.behavior: Record received quantities and confirm in Dashboard or eligible POS; Dashboard can transfer instantly.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Cannot lower requested amount below already received; detailed damaged/cancel receipt behavior not explicit in inspected guide.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure transfer discrepancy and closure time.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Goods receipt independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Keep transfer accounting distinct from settlement.
claims.acceptance_test: Receive partial quantity and verify received amount recorded and remaining amount stays actionable.

claims.capability: Create location
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can separate profile, hours, reporting and device/catalog context.
claims.behavior: Create location in Dashboard and enter profile/contact details.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Cannot delete; deactivate only; device-code Register cannot switch location.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure second-site setup errors.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Location model independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Tender records must retain origin location.
claims.acceptance_test: Create second location and verify report scope plus deactivate-not-delete behavior.

claims.capability: Create/import customer profile
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can retain customer details and interaction history.
claims.behavior: Create directly, during/after sale, or import from Dashboard; import summary distinguishes created, matched and failed rows, with failed-row download/reimport; changes sync with POS.
recovery_edge_cases: Import can take minutes; matched records may be updated; failed rows produce correction file; deleting imported group does not remove pre-existing loyalty accounts. Import does not resubscribe unsubscribed customers.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure duplicate/import failure rate.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Customer record independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Minimize customer data collected for Bitcoin tender.
claims.acceptance_test: Import profile and verify sync to POS; confirm note field sensitive-data guidance.

claims.capability: Merge duplicate or delete customer profile
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can correct directory duplicates or honor deletion request.
claims.behavior: Review phone/email duplicate suggestion; merge or delete in Dashboard/POS.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Merge irreversible; accidental delete recovery requires Support within 30 days.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Preview merge consequences before commit.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Customer records independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Do not add wallet data to profile without need.
claims.acceptance_test: Merge duplicates after review and verify irreversible confirmation and recovery guidance.

claims.capability: Migrate stored card-on-file data
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can request credential export for processor migration.
claims.behavior: Use documented card-on-file export process.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Not general customer-contact export.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Provide status visibility and destination verification.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Bitcoin does not replace stored-card migration.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Merchant may still need migration for card customers.
claims.acceptance_test: Track card export request and distinguish it from directory CSV export.

claims.capability: Route customer data access/deletion/portability requests
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can distinguish its data from Square-held data.
claims.behavior: Handle own copies/processors and contact Square for data Square holds.
qualifiers: US-hosted GDPR guide scoped to EU rights
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Not universal US legal workflow; retention exceptions vary.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure completeness and resolution time.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Applies across tender types.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: New tender data does not remove retention duties.
claims.acceptance_test: For an EU request, identify merchant/Square-held data and route applicable request.

claims.capability: Export customer contact list
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant wants portable directory.
claims.behavior: No official leaf documenting general contact CSV export surfaced; community pages are nonofficial and excluded.
recovery_edge_cases: Opened official customer-directory guide documents bulk import, but no general export workflow or output schema. Official card-on-file credential migration export is separate. Keep general export behavior unknown.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Document schema and privacy controls.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Portability independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Bitcoin does not remove portability need.
claims.acceptance_test: Acceptance remains undefined until official source is found.

claims.capability: Configure loyalty earning/rewards/locations
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant defines point earning and reward rules.
claims.behavior: Dashboard configures spend/item/visit points, rewards, location participation and optional expiry.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Free item/combo needs local item/category configured at every location.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure rule setup and location failures.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Program earns regardless of payment method.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Preserve eligibility across tender unless merchant rules differ.
claims.acceptance_test: Configure two-location free item reward and verify location mapping is required.

claims.capability: Enroll and redeem loyalty reward
claims.merchant_outcome: Customer can join program and use eligible reward.
claims.behavior: Enter phone at checkout or claim via invite; redeem POS or Square Online.
qualifiers: Invoice earns points but cannot redeem
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Post-sale invite may be delayed; invoice redemption unavailable.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure enroll and claim completion.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Earning documented regardless how customer pays.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Preserve earn/redeem workflow for Bitcoin tender.
claims.acceptance_test: Enroll and redeem at POS; separately verify invoice earns but cannot redeem.

claims.capability: Sell and deliver gift card
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant sells stored value via POS/Dashboard or online page.
claims.behavior: Sell physical/eGift; enable online page; resend eGift if needed.
qualifiers: eGift restrictions on custom domains/API/eCommerce partners
claims.recovery_edge_cases: POS cannot auto-text eGift; online page is Square-based.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure delivery failure and expose limits.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Gift value distinct from Bitcoin tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Do not treat Bitcoin receipt as stored value.
claims.acceptance_test: Sell within limits, verify activation and resend to corrected recipient.

claims.capability: Accept gift card and handle insufficient balance
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant redeems stored value and completes remainder if needed.
claims.behavior: Scan/swipe/enter code; split tender or cancel if insufficient physical balance.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Location attribution uses selected reporting location.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure declines and split completion.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Gift card and Bitcoin are separate tenders.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Reconcile each balance separately.
claims.acceptance_test: Redeem low-balance card with split tender and confirm offline restriction.

claims.capability: Reload eGift card
claims.merchant_outcome: Seller or customer adds stored value.
claims.behavior: Seller reloads in POS using number/QR; customer can reload online with number and applicable PIN.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: PIN may be required online.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure lookup failures.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Reload independent of Bitcoin.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Keep stored-value liability separate.
claims.acceptance_test: Reload via POS QR and online credentials and verify amount.

claims.capability: Check gift card balance
claims.merchant_outcome: Customer or cashier confirms remaining value.
claims.behavior: Staff scans/swipes/enters number; customer uses balance page/profile with PIN or no-PIN option.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: If PIN lookup fails, customer contacts seller.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Reduce lookup failure and support burden.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Do not conflate gift balance with Bitcoin balance.
claims.acceptance_test: Check PIN and no-PIN card paths and seller fallback.

claims.capability: Connect printer and assign print profile
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant routes receipt/kitchen jobs to device.
claims.behavior: Connect compatible network/USB/Bluetooth/AirPrint printer, create profile and assign jobs/device.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: USB tied to one POS; iOS direct USB unsupported; unprofiled device limited; profile affects all assigned printers.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure pairing/misrouting errors.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Printer independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Tender-specific print content requires separate evidence.
claims.acceptance_test: Connect printer, assign profile, test; verify same-network and unprofiled conditions.

claims.capability: Set up Terminal and check accessories
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant prepares portable POS device.
claims.behavior: Use on-device setup guide, load paper, test printer, select exact model for accessory list.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Check exact accessory SKU before purchase.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure setup completion and accessory mismatch.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Hardware setup independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: This guide does not establish Bitcoin software compatibility.
claims.acceptance_test: Run printer test and verify compatibility list keyed to Terminal.

claims.capability: Configure modifier set behavior
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant controls prompts, receipt visibility and sold-out presentation.
claims.behavior: Configure receipt hiding, conversational prompts and sort-sold-out-last.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Conversational and multi-quantity options conflict; sort-last also conflicts with conversational.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Preview incompatible settings before saving.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Modifiers should behave the same across tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Tender must not bypass required modifiers.
claims.acceptance_test: Set text limit and attempt incompatible settings; verify constraints are explained.

claims.capability: Switch location and view scoped activity
claims.merchant_outcome: Operator works in correct site context.
claims.trigger: Move between stores or review results
claims.behavior: Switch POS location and view location-specific catalog/report/device context.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Location cannot be deleted.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Reduce wrong-location activity.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Tender should retain location.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Bitcoin activity reports under originating location.
claims.acceptance_test: Switch compatible POS location and verify scope; disclose Register device-code limitation.

claims.capability: Set item availability and sellable quantity
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can pause or cap sales independently from stocktake.
claims.behavior: Set available/sold out/quantity and reset; status syncs across supported sales channels.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Available without quantity means unlimited; reset defaults to end business day; on-hand differs from committed stock.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Reduce oversells and stale state.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Availability applies irrespective tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Bitcoin flow honors availability and committed quantity.
claims.acceptance_test: Set quantity cap and reset; verify channel propagation and committed/on-hand distinction.

claims.capability: Decrement tracked stock after supported sale
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant stock reflects completed sales from configured Square channels.
claims.trigger: Tracked item sells through supported channel
claims.behavior: Stock updates from POS, Invoices and online-store shipped orders.
qualifiers: Square POS, Square Invoices, online shipped orders
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Untracked items do not decrement; do not assume external integrated channels without documentation.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure sale-to-stock lag and duplicate/missed decrements.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Completed tender sale must decrement exactly once.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Additional tender integration can duplicate or omit decrement without clear event ownership.
claims.acceptance_test: Sell one tracked unit through each documented channel and verify one decrement for each sale.

claims.capability: Receive all, none or part of purchase order
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can update stock to match supplier delivery and record ancillary costs.
claims.behavior: Mark all/none or enter partial quantity; add shipping/handling fee when receiving; record damaged or unfulfilled quantity.
recovery_edge_cases: Damaged/theft/loss flags do not appear in COGS per guide; fees allocate across items and do not change unit cost.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure discrepancy handling and cost allocation clarity.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Supplier receipt job is independent of customer tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Avoid implying Bitcoin settles supplier invoice.
claims.acceptance_test: Partially receive a PO, record damaged quantity and shipping fee, then verify received units and COGS allocation.

claims.capability: Associate vendor code with item for lookup
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can match supplier identifiers to catalog variations during ordering/receiving.
claims.behavior: Add vendor code alongside Square SKU; search by vendor code or scan supported barcode when receiving.
preconditions: Eligible Retail POS for barcode receipt
qualifiers: Vendor codes distinct from Square SKU
recovery_edge_cases: CSV/spreadsheet formatting may alter identifiers; verify leading zeroes.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure item lookup failures and wrong-item receipt.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Vendor lookup independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Keep supplier identifiers separate from payment reference.
claims.acceptance_test: Add vendor code with leading zero, search and scan it in supported Retail POS; verify correct variation selected.

claims.capability: Record cash paid in or paid out during active drawer
claims.merchant_outcome: Manager can document cash movement outside sales.
claims.trigger: Cash added to or removed from drawer
claims.behavior: Enter amount and description and choose Pay In or Pay Out on POS.
recovery_edge_cases: Remote Dashboard end prevents further paid-in/out adjustments.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure unannotated cash movement and reconciliation time.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Cash movements remain separate from Bitcoin settlement.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Do not include non-cash receipts in physical drawer paid-in/out.
claims.acceptance_test: Record one pay-in and one pay-out with descriptions and verify both appear in drawer history.

claims.capability: End or close cash drawer session
claims.merchant_outcome: Manager can record actual counted cash and finish drawer session.
claims.behavior: End drawer from POS or Dashboard; when closing with count, enter actual amount, description and report email.
qualifiers: Ending differs from closing with actual amount
recovery_edge_cases: Dashboard remote end prevents subsequent paid-in/out; active sessions may auto-end after long inactivity.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure variance investigation and incomplete closes.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Cash closeout retains value when Bitcoin reduces cash tender mix.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Expected-versus-counted cash must exclude noncash Bitcoin sales.
claims.acceptance_test: End a session with actual cash amount and verify expected and counted values; separately end without count and verify distinction.

claims.capability: Export inventory count variance and summary
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can review count discrepancy and identify who counted/reviewed and when.
claims.behavior: Export Items CSV with item counts/variance or Count summary CSV with counters/reviewers/timestamps.
preconditions: Completed or supported in-progress full count
recovery_edge_cases: Missing unit costs may make inventory valuation and total variance inaccurate; active cycle count blocks full count access.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure time to resolve stock variance; surface missing unit costs before export.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Variance reporting independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Ensure sale feed includes all accepted tender before comparing physical count.
claims.acceptance_test: Export both CSVs and verify item variance and reviewer/timestamp summary fields.

claims.capability: Connect a compatible barcode scanner
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can scan items for lookup, checkout and inventory workflows.
claims.behavior: Pair supported Bluetooth scanner on iOS, plug compatible USB scanner into hub/Android OTG, or enable camera scanning on compatible phone/tablet.
qualifiers: Android USB requires Android 9+ and OTG/host
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Scanner compatibility varies by model; iOS camera requires camera permission; supported scan page indicator is shown.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure setup failures and scan latency; identify device/scanner compatibility before pairing.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Scanning workflow independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Ensure scanning selects same catalog item regardless tender.
claims.acceptance_test: Pair compatible Bluetooth scanner on iPad and scan item; separately verify unsupported Android Bluetooth path is not offered and camera permission path works.

claims.capability: Recover barcode scanner pairing or camera failures
claims.merchant_outcome: Operator can restore scanning without replacing POS workflow.
claims.trigger: Scanner fails to pair or camera scan stops
claims.behavior: Check charge, compatibility, pairing/device attachment, Bluetooth/camera settings, permissions, supported screen and lighting; reset/restart as guide directs.
qualifiers: Recovery differs by scanner and OS
claims.recovery_edge_cases: A scanner paired to a different device may need unpair/reset; restarting app/device may be required.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure time to restore scanning; present diagnostics based on scanner type and operating system.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Recovery is tender-independent.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Payment method changes should not disrupt item scanning.
claims.acceptance_test: Induce disconnected Bluetooth and camera permission cases; follow recovery guide and confirm scanning resumes.

claims.capability: Set up Square Handheld for a location
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can deploy a portable inventory/order device.
claims.behavior: Connect power/network, perform mandatory first software update, sign in and configure date/time/language.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Mandatory activation update cannot be skipped; third-party charger/accessory compatibility not guaranteed.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure first setup completion and connection failure.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Setup independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Do not assume unsupported networks support payment operations.
claims.acceptance_test: Set up Handheld on private Wi-Fi, complete update, and verify captive portal is rejected with actionable guidance.

claims.capability: Set up self-service Square Kiosk mode and location
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can deploy a configured self-service ordering station.
claims.behavior: Install mount, connect stable network, create Dashboard kiosk mode/device code, select location/menu/settings and sign in.
preconditions: Square Plus/Premium or eligible advanced restaurants capability
qualifiers: Legacy restaurant plans may require migration
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Offline and cash payments unsupported; indoor only; mount hardware sold separately; stable network required for voice ordering.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure setup and menu/location mismatch; provide readiness gate for subscription, network, mode, menu and mounting.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Hardware setup independent of tender.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Kiosk offline/cash limitations must be respected regardless of other tender availability.
claims.acceptance_test: Create kiosk mode with location/menu, sign in, verify location-specific menu, and confirm offline/cash paths are unavailable.

claims.capability: Review customer import matching and failed rows
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can update existing records from import while identifying errors and undoing import batch changes.
claims.behavior: Review created/matched/failed summary; download failed rows for correction/reimport; delete imported group if rollback needed.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Matched rows may add details to existing profiles; deleting group does not affect loyalty accounts that predated import.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure import matching accuracy and rollback errors.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Import reconciliation independent of payment method.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Do not use payment rail identifiers as uncontrolled customer matching keys.
claims.acceptance_test: Import duplicate and invalid rows; verify matched data updates, failures downloadable and group rollback preserves pre-existing loyalty.

claims.capability: Apply documented email marketing status on profile entry
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant understands effect of entering customer email into profile.
claims.behavior: Square guide states manually entering email into profile automatically opts customer into email marketing.
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Import tool cannot subscribe previously unsubscribed customers; ensure staff follows applicable consent requirements.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure consent confusion and opt-out requests; make subscription state and consent basis visible at capture.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Marketing subscription independent of Bitcoin.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Do not condition marketing enrollment on tender selection.
claims.acceptance_test: Enter an email on a test profile and verify resulting marketing status is visible; verify import does not resubscribe an unsubscribed profile.

claims.capability: Export customer-provided names and emails for third-party marketing
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can reuse contact details customers provided directly to the business in an external marketing service.
claims.behavior: Use Customer Directory information provided by customers for Square Marketing or export for a third-party marketing service.
preconditions: Customer-provided names/emails saved in Customer Directory
qualifiers: US guide documents permitted use/export purpose, not general CSV schema or export steps
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Contacts supplied to another seller for automatic receipts/marketing are Square-controlled and masked, not merchant-owned export data.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure successful export and field completeness; distinguish directly provided records from masked contacts before export.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Keep card-provider and Bitcoin transaction metadata out of marketing lists unless the customer separately provides/authorizes contact use.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: External marketing export adds privacy and format work and does not improve Bitcoin settlement; preserve tender-independent consent and contact handling.
claims.acceptance_test: Verify customer-provided names/emails are eligible for external marketing use and another seller’s masked contact is not. Do not assert CSV fields or button path from this US guide.

claims.capability: Collect mailing-list signups through POS, hosted page or embedded form
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can collect voluntary mailing-list signups at checkout or online.
claims.trigger: Customer chooses to join mailing list
claims.behavior: Enable post-purchase POS signup, share hosted URL, or embed signup widget; collected name/email is added to Customer Directory.
preconditions: Email Marketing add-on for POS signup
qualifiers: Email Marketing add-on not available on Square Register
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Signup choice is distinct from required transaction handling or receipt delivery.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Measure signup completion and form errors; show resulting Collected Emails group and channel.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Keep marketing signup independent of whether customer pays by card or Bitcoin.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Shared order flow may reduce duplicate entry, but consent/contact capture remains a separate customer choice.
claims.acceptance_test: Configure POS, hosted and embedded signup paths; submit test entries and verify directory group; verify Square Register add-on limitation is shown.

claims.capability: Respect masked contact boundary for other-seller customer data
claims.merchant_outcome: Merchant can distinguish directly provided contacts from Square-masked contacts another seller collected.
claims.trigger: Merchant views contact or plans outreach
claims.behavior: Directly provided checkout details are co-controlled and visible; another-seller contacts remain Square-controlled and masked, with outreach limited to customers who purchased from merchant within the prior 12 months.
preconditions: Qualifying merchant purchase history for allowed masked outreach
claims.recovery_edge_cases: Do not export masked address or treat it as merchant-owned.
claims.improvement_hypothesis: Reduce inappropriate outreach by showing contact source/ownership and purchase window.
claims.bitcoin_hypothesis: Bitcoin tender does not change ownership or masking status of customer contact data.
claims.bitcoin_tradeoffs: Merchant may need separate customer-provided contact for follow-up; payment metadata does not grant unmasking or marketing permission.
claims.acceptance_test: Compare directly provided and other-seller contact records: verify direct data visible/co-controlled, other record masked, and outreach qualification uses past-12-month purchase condition.

limitations: All evidence is public US Square Support Center documentation inspected on the recorded date; no Square account or workflow was tested. Documentation does not prove real-world compatibility.
This is a partial domain bundle, not exhaustive Square research. Coverage ledger marks uninspected customer, loyalty, gift card, privacy/export/deletion, location and hardware areas unresolved.

Square guide eligibility changes by product mode, country, subscription, device, permissions and add-on. Exact conditions in each inspected source should be checked against current merchant configuration.
Transfer order guide body and full lifecycle were not inspected; only index/search result evidence is recorded.

Catalog import/export, modifier stock availability, customer directory/data portability, loyalty, gift cards, hardware compatibility/setup and multi-location setup require further exact-guide inspection.
Square payroll and banking/financial services are adjacent coverage exclusions. No implementation or acceptance commitment is made for them.
